title: How It
subtitle: Get started in four simple steps. From discovery to funding, we've streamlined the entire process.

step1.title: Browse Opportunities
step1.description: Explore funding opportunities across various sectors. Filter by location, funding amount, and sector to find the perfect match.

step2.title: Create Your Profile
step2.description: Sign up in minutes and create your entrepreneur profile. Showcase your business, experience, and vision.

step3.title: Submit Application
step3.description: Complete your application with our guided process. Upload documents, provide details, and submit with confidence.

step4.title: Get Funded
step4.description: Track your application status in real-time. Receive feedback and get funded to grow your business.
